description: This file defines the StandardCalculatorPage class, which provides UI automation objects and helper methods for interacting with the calculator in Standard Mode within a test framework. It includes methods for navigating to standard mode, clearing the calculator, and ensuring the calculator is in the correct mode.

classes.name: StandardCalculatorPage
classes.description: Represents the UI automation layer for the calculator's Standard Mode, providing methods to navigate, clear, and verify the calculator's state during automated tests.

methods.name: NavigateToStandardCalculator
methods.description: Navigates the calculator to Standard mode and verifies that it is in standard mode.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears the calculator display, memory panel, and history panel.

methods.name: EnsureCalculatorResultTextIsZero
methods.description: Checks if the calculator display is zero; if not, clears all to reset.

methods.name: EnsureCalculatorIsInStandardMode
methods.description: Verifies that the calculator is in Standard mode, navigating if necessary.
